summary: Frontend-only test of Cycle Coach UI update (adv_active@test.com, 1920x1080, 390x844, 1920x800). Everything requested works: the Typical Bleeding Duration control (order, defaults, 3-7 range, saving, keeping other settings), the Predictor changes (Advanced Settings removed, saved value used), the new Coaching Manual section, and logging/deleting a period. Found one minor content/testid issue in the new section and one older dashboard bug (not from this change). No payment/billing actions were taken.
verified: bleeding-duration-section sits between Log New Period (top 441) and Recent Cycles (top 725); title and description text correct
Default '5 days' when no settings are saved. Plus 5->6->7 then disabled; an extra forced click stays at 7. Minus 7->6->5->4->3 then disabled. Each step changes by exactly 1
localStorage cyclecoach_cycle_settings_<uid> = {lutealConstant:14, menstrualLength:3/6} saves each change. Value 6 still there after closing the dialog and reloading
Pre-set {lutealConstant:13, menstrualLength:4} -> shows '4 days'; plus -> {lutealConstant:13, menstrualLength:5} (lutealConstant kept)
Out-of-range saved value 10 is shown clamped to '7 days' with plus disabled
The dashboard phase updates right away when the value changes (cycle day 10: Phase 2 Day 5 at 5 days, Day 4 at 6 days)

/predictor: no 'Advanced Settings' text and no setting-menstrual-length / setting-luteal-constant inputs. Menstrual card shows 'Days 1–6' at 6 and 'Days 1–3' at 3. Predicting Nov 6 (cycle day 6) gives Menstrual at 6 and Follicular at 3. estimate-disclaimer-predictor is visible
Coaching Manual tab: 'Understanding Ovulation Tracking' heading, manual-ovulation-optional-note text, OPKs/BBT/Luteal Phase open with the correct definitions
Logging a period (11/9) adds a row and updates the stats. Deleting cycle-0 removes it with a toast
390x844: no horizontal overflow in the dashboard, dialog or predictor; -/+ buttons 48x48, value 24px. 1920x800: dialog fits, buttons 56x56

ui_bugs.issue: 'Basal Body Temperature (BBT)' now appears twice: under General Terms (older definition) and under the new Understanding Ovulation Tracking section. This duplicates the content and gives two elements the same data-testids, manual-btn-basal-body-temperature--bbt- and manual-term-... (strict-mode selector clash). Toggling still works on its own because keys include the category.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard handleDeleteCycle (older bug, not from this change)
ui_bugs.issue: After deleting the current/latest cycle, the dashboard phase card keeps the deleted cycle's info (showed 'Day 2 / Phase 1' instead of Day 10) until the page is reloaded. Cause: line 726 calls loadCycleInfoLocal(partner) with the old partner state instead of updatedPartner.

issues: The bleeding-duration container uses bg-slate-800, the same color as DialogContent (bg-slate-800). The 'dark-gray container' is therefore invisible, while the Log New Period block above uses bg-white/10. Use something like bg-slate-900/60 or bg-white/5 with a border so the section stands out.
delete-cycle-N buttons are 32x32, below the 48px touch target (older issue)

action_items: Remove the duplicate BBT entry from General Terms, or give the testid a section prefix, so there is a single BBT definition
Dashboard.jsx handleDeleteCycle: call loadCycleInfoLocal(updatedPartner) (or the latest partner) instead of the stale `partner`
Give BleedingDurationControl a background that contrasts with the dialog (e.g. bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-700)
critical_code_review_comments: BleedingDurationControl reads settings only once, via useState init. This is fine because the dialog content remounts each time it opens, but the control will not pick up changes made elsewhere while it stays mounted
PhasePredictor still calls LocalStorage.getCycleHistory/getPartnerProfile (decrypt) on every render; consider memoizing
Dashboard.jsx is 1343 lines; consider splitting it

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed; 1 low and 1 medium (older) issue found

seed_data_creation: Only browser localStorage in ephemeral Playwright contexts (partner TEST_Partner, cycle 11/1). No server data changed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding: pick 'Outside the United States' in state-privacy-waiver, click privacy-continue-btn, tick both checkboxes and click 'Continue'. Then the partner setup form: partner-name-input, click cycle-start-date-input, pick a button[name=day], create-partner-button. The Coaching Manual is behind tab-coaching-manual. The cycle history dialog opens with toggle-cycle-history-button. Delete uses window.confirm. Each browser_automation call starts with fresh localStorage.
